item.title: Galápagos sea turtles surprised scientists by staying close to home
item.description: Yellow-morph green sea turtles in the Galápagos stayed remarkably close to home instead of making the long journeys scientists expected.

item.title: Earth's day isn't exactly 24 hours, and the reason may be inside the planet
item.description: Scientists may have solved why Earth's day length changes by milliseconds over decades. Shifts in the inner core appear to tug on the planet.
